---
name: "benchmark-analysis"
description: "Interpreting Lichtblick benchmark reports: artifact layout, benchmark-result.v1 and overhead schema 3 JSON paths, read-only Node extraction recipes, a metric-to-code catalog (every telemetry metric, event and KPI mapped to its producer and the product code that influences it), interpretation pitfalls, baseline comparison rules, an evidence-first analysis workflow and the findings output contract."

# Benchmark Analysis

Knowledge base for reading the artifacts written by `benchmark/e2e` (Playwright runner) and
connecting what they show to the code that produced the numbers. The main source of truth is
[`benchmark/README.md`](../../../benchmark/README.md); this skill condenses it and adds the code map.

> **Line numbers drift.** Every reference has the form `path:line` (`symbol`). If the line no
> longer contains the symbol, re-grep the symbol in that file (`grep -n "<symbol>" <path>`) and
> use the new line. Never cite a line you have not re-read.

Scenario abbreviations used below: **sw** = `sinewave`, **pc** = `pointcloud`, **tf** =
`transform`, **tfp** = `transformpreloading`, **mmi** = `mcap-multi-ingest`, **all** = every
scenario under test (`benchmark/e2e/runner/scenariosUnderTest.ts:10` (`SCENARIOS_UNDER_TEST`)).

---

## 1. Inputs

| Input               | Where                                                                                                                                         | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Local run           | `benchmark/.artifacts/`                                                                                                                       | Gitignored. Written by `yarn test:e2e:benchmark` (Electron) / `yarn test:e2e:benchmark:web`. Also contains `fixtures/` (generated MCAPs, ignore) and `report/` (viewer output).                                                                         |
| CI run              | Workflow artifacts `benchmark-results-electron` / `benchmark-results-web` (`.github/workflows/e2e-benchmark.yml`, pushes to `develop`/`main`) | Zip root mirrors `benchmark/.artifacts/`: `*.json`, `screenshots/`, `report/`. CI runs only the `scenarios` spec, so there are **no overhead reports** in CI artifacts. Download with `gh run download <runId> -n benchmark-results-electron -D <dir>`. |
| Baseline (optional) | Any directory with the same layout                                                                                                            | E.g. a CI artifact of `develop`, or a local run on the base commit.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Focus (optional)    | scenario id, platform (`electron`/`web`), metric or KPI                                                                                       | Restricts triage; still validate the environment first.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

### File naming

v1 names are built by `benchmark/e2e/runner/artifacts.ts:30` (`resultV1FileName`):
`<scenarioId>-<platform>[-telemetry-off][-<variant>]-<ts>.benchmark-result.v1.json`; overhead arm
variants come from `benchmark/e2e/runner/constants.ts:237` (`OVERHEAD_ARM_FILE_VARIANTS`).

| Pattern                                                                                                                                      | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<scenarioId>-<platform>-<ts>.benchmark-result.v1.json`                                                                                      | Scenario run, telemetry on (`run.mode: "scenario"`; `run.mode` is absent in older files).                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `<scenarioId>-<platform>-telemetry-off-<ts>.benchmark-result.v1.json`                                                                        | Scenario run with `?telemetry=off` (`run.telemetryEnabled: false`); only host/frame data.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `<scenarioId>-<platform>-overhead-<ts>.benchmark-result.v1.json`                                                                             | Overhead `on` arm (`run.mode: "overhead"`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `<scenarioId>-<platform>-telemetry-off-overhead-<ts>.benchmark-result.v1.json`                                                               | Overhead `off` arm (`run.mode: "overhead"`, `run.telemetryEnabled: false`).                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `<scenarioId>-web-overhead-ua-memory-off-<ts>.benchmark-result.v1.json`                                                                      | Overhead `on-noUa` arm (telemetry on, UA-memory probe off; `BENCHMARK_OVERHEAD_UA_ARM=1`).                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Legacy overhead arms: `<scenarioId>-<platform>-<ts>…`, `<scenarioId>-<platform>-telemetry-off-<ts>…`, `<scenarioId>-web-ua-memory-off-<ts>…` | Written before `run.mode` and the `-overhead` tag existed: **they look like scenario files** but carry `summary.steadyWindow` (and `summary.telemetrySelf` on the telemetry-on arms).                                                                                         |
| `overhead-<platform>-<scenarioId>-<ts>.json`                                                                                                 | Overhead report (schema 3, see §2.3).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `<scenarioId>-<ts>.json`, `<scenarioId>-web-<ts>.json`                                                                                       | Legacy summary `{scenarioId, pipeline, startedAt, finishedAt, memorySamples, frameTimeSamples}`; superseded by v1, use only when v1 is missing.                                                                                                                               |
| `screenshots/<scenarioId>-<platform>[-telemetry-off]-<ts>-<checkpoint>.png`                                                                  | Scenario-spec screenshots (`benchmark/e2e/runner/screenshots.ts:77` (`screenshotFileName`)); `end` by default, plus `loaded` and `mid` with `BENCHMARK_SCREENSHOTS=all`. The screenshot mode is not stored in the JSON; `-loaded`/`-mid` PNGs with the same `<ts>` reveal it. |

**Every overhead arm (current or legacy) is excluded from KPIs/scorecard**
(`benchmark/e2e/result/runMode.ts:16` (`isOverheadRun`)).

`<ts>` is the epoch ms at run start, so **the newest run of a group is the file with the largest
`<ts>`** (cross-check `run.startedAtWall`). Group files by
`scenarioId|platform|mode|telemetry|uaMemory` before picking the newest:

- `mode` = `run.mode`; if absent, `overhead` when `summary.steadyWindow` is present, else
  `scenario` (same rule as `isOverheadRun`). Never derive the mode from the file name alone.
- `telemetry` = `run.telemetryEnabled` (`on`/`off`).
- `uaMemory` = `run.environment.collectors.uaMemory`: `on`, `off` (`?telemetry.uaMemory=off`),
  `unsupported` (Electron, headless shell) or `disabled` (telemetry off)
  (`benchmark/e2e/result/telemetrySelf.types.ts:28` (`CollectorsStateV1`)); **missing = not
  recorded** (scenario runs and older files; only overhead runs record it).

§2.4 has a tested recipe that does this grouping.

### Tools that read the same files

- `yarn test:e2e:benchmark:viewer [--all] [--dir <path>] [--open]` → self-contained HTML at
  `<dir>/report/index.html` (scorecard, group KPIs, per-run charts, exercised components,
  overhead reports). Default = newest run per scenario/platform; `--all` = every run.
- `yarn test:e2e:benchmark:summary` → markdown summary of `benchmark/.artifacts/` only (the
  directory is hardcoded; copy a baseline elsewhere and use the viewer `--dir` for it).

Both tools compute views that are **not persisted** in the JSON: the scorecard, group KPIs and
exercised components (`benchmark/e2e/result/exercised.ts:64` (`exercisedComponents`)). Recompute
them by reading the code, or ask the user to open the viewer; do not guess.

---

## 2. Artifact & schema guide

### 2.1 `benchmark-result.v1` (built by `benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:803` (`buildResultV1`))

Top level: `schemaVersion`, `run`, `samples[]`, `events[]`, `dropped`, `sequenceGaps`,
`runnerEvents[]`, `summary`.

| JSON path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `run.scenarioId`, `run.pipeline`, `run.platform`, `run.telemetryEnabled`, `run.mode`                                                                                                                                                        | Identity. `mode` is `"scenario"` or `"overhead"`; absent in older files (resolve it as in §1).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `run.startMonotonicTs`, `run.endMonotonicTs`, `run.windowEndMonotonicTs`, `run.sampleIntervalMs`                                                                                                                                            | Renderer monotonic clock, ms. Measurement window = `windowEndMonotonicTs − startMonotonicTs` (`benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:173` (`windowEndMonotonicTs`); older files lack it, then `endMonotonicTs` is used); `endMonotonicTs` also covers teardown.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `run.startedAtWall`, `run.finishedAtWall`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Wall-clock ISO timestamps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `run.environment.{os, arch, ci, cpuModel, logicalCpus, totalMemBytes}`                                                                                                                                                                      | Host. **Compare before any delta.** `logicalCpus` is absent in older files (and then Electron CPU is on a different scale, §4.19).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `run.environment.{userAgent, chromiumVersion, electronVersion, webBrowser, crossOriginIsolated}`                                                                                                                                            | Runtime. `webBrowser` is `chromium-headless-shell` for scenario runs and `chromium` for overhead runs; absent on Electron and in older web files.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `run.environment.{fpsCeiling, glRenderer, lateFrameThresholdMs}`                                                                                                                                                                            | Frame calibration (see §4).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `run.environment.collectors.uaMemory`                                                                                                                                                                                                       | UA-memory probe state `on`/`off`/`unsupported`/`disabled`; recorded only by overhead runs (missing = not recorded, see §1).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `run.scenario.{id, group, tags, layout, dataSource, player, params, durationMs, panels[]}`                                                                                                                                                  | Scenario descriptor copy; URLs in `params` are `"<redacted>"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `samples[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `{kind:"sample", realm, sequence, monotonicTs, metric, value, unit, scope, metricType, labels}`. Histograms from `telemetry.observe` appear as `<metric>.count`, `<metric>.sum` (counters) and `<metric>.max` (gauge).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `events[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `{kind:"event", realm, sequence, monotonicTs, name, phase, scope, labels?}`; `phase` is `"start"`/`"end"`/`"instant"` (`packages/suite-base/src/util/telemetry/types.ts:17` (`TelemetryPhase`)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `dropped`, `sequenceGaps`                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Objects keyed by realm (`benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:300` (`dropped`), `benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:301` (`sequenceGaps`)), e.g. `"sequenceGaps": {"renderer":0,"worker:1":0}`; `{}` when nothing was recorded. **Any value > 0** means an incomplete series.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `summary.process.{sampleCount, peakTotalWorkingSetBytes, meanTotalWorkingSetBytes, medianTotalCpuPercent, cpuSeconds, totalWorkingSetSlopeMiBPerMin?}`                                                                                      | Host totals over all processes (`benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:515` (`summarizeProcess`)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `summary.process.byType.<browser\|gpu\|renderer\|utility>.{peakWorkingSetBytes, medianCpuPercent}`                                                                                                                                          | Per process type.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `summary.renderer.{peakJsHeapUsedBytes, medianFps, lateFrames, totalFrames, longTasks, longTaskTotalMs}`                                                                                                                                    | Main-thread page (`benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:584` (`summarizeRenderer`)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `summary.phases.{origin, firstMessageMs, firstUsefulFrameMs, openDurationMs, preloadDurationMs, layoutAppliedMs, panelsReadyMs, panelsReadyCoverage{mounted, firstRendered}}`                                                               | Startup, ms relative to `origin` (`app.ready` for synthetic players, `datasource.open` for `IterablePlayer`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `summary.listenerDispatchDurationMs.{count, p50, p90, max}`                                                                                                                                                                                 | Benchmark-player listener dispatch (sw, pc, tf only); a true distribution over every dispatch.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `summary.panels["<panelId>"].{panelType, mounts, messages, messageBytes, rangeMessages, rangeBytes, mountedAtMs, unmountedAtMs, firstRenderMs, renders, renderMeanMs, renderMaxMs, renderP90WindowMaxMs, skipped}`                          | Per-panel telemetry. `renderP90WindowMaxMs` is the p90 of per-window maxima (§3.4).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `summary.pipeline.{messagesReceived, bytesReceived, rateWindowMs, messagesPerSec, bytesPerSec, deliveredFanout, subscribersMax, subscriptionsMax, listenerDispatchMeanMs, listenerDispatchMaxMs, listenerDispatchP90WindowMaxMs}`           | MessagePipeline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `summary.pipeline.{blockCachePeakBytes, blockCacheMaxBytes, sourceCacheMisses, sourceCacheHitRatio, sourceCachePeakBytes, remoteReadRequests, remoteBytesRead, sourcesTotal, sourcesRelevant, memoryPeakBytes["<key>/<sourceId>"]}`         | Player-side fields, present only for `IterablePlayer` scenarios (mmi).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `summary.hydratedSourcePool.pools["<realm>/<poolId>"].{acquires, releases, terminatedPins, activePinsFinal, invariantHolds, overBudgetPeriods, overBudgetDurationMs, evictions, rehydrations, highWaterResidentCount, highWaterActivePins}` | Pool summary (`benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:683` (`summarizePool`)); key looks like `worker:1/pool-1`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `summary.runnerEvents`                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Counts of `renderer.crash`, `process.gone`, `renderer.reload`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `summary.steadyWindow` (overhead runs only)                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `{warmupMs, requestedPolls, polls, overruns, windowMismatch, maxPollLatencyMs, clockSyncRttMs, meanWorkingSetBytesByType, processSet, mainThread{longTaskBlockedMsPerSec, fps}, …}`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `summary.telemetrySelf`                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `{windowSec, msPerSec{total, byComponent{collectors, frames, longTasks, sinkPublish, drain, uaMemory}}, recordsPerSec, uaCalls, uaResolved, uaFailures, uaResolveMsMean, emitCostNs{gaugeNs, counterNs, eventNs}, meanEmitNs, estimatedEmitMsPerSec, fractionOfCore}`. **Present only in overhead runs with telemetry on** (`benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:292` (`telemetrySelf`), validator `benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:1245` (`telemetrySelf`)); absent in scenario runs and in off arms by design. |
| `summary.kpis`                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Run KPIs (§2.2). `recomputed: true` means the viewer backfilled them from an older file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

A run that hit a panel error boundary fails the test **before** the v1 JSON is written
(`benchmark/e2e/runner/errorBoundaries.ts:25` (`collectErrorBoundaryHits`)). A missing newest
file for a scenario is therefore evidence in itself; check the Playwright report.

### 2.2 KPIs, scorecard and group KPIs

`summary.kpis` is built by `benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:140` (`computeRunKpis`):

| JSON path                                                                                                           | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `kpis.stability.{healthy, reasons}`                                                                                 | `benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:50` (`unhealthyReasons`): any runner event (crash, process gone, reload), a violated pool invariant, or dropped telemetry records. Unhealthy runs are not comparable. Check `sequenceGaps` separately.                                                                                                                         |
| `kpis.memory.peakTotalWorkingSetMiB`                                                                                | `summary.process.peakTotalWorkingSetBytes` in MiB.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `kpis.memory.workingSetSlopeMiBPerMin`                                                                              | Steady-state slope; absent for windows < 10 s.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `kpis.cpu.{medianCpuPercent, cpuSeconds, cpuSecondsPerMiB}`                                                         | `benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:82` (`cpuKpis`). `cpuSecondsPerMiB` divides by ingested MiB (`pipeline.bytesPerSec` × window length, `benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:86` (`windowEndMonotonicTs`)).                                                                                                                                                              |
| `kpis.smoothness.{medianFps, fpsCeiling, fpsPercentOfCeiling, onTimeFramePercent, longTaskBlockedMsPerSec, lowFps}` | `benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:98` (`smoothnessKpis`). `lowFps` = `medianFps` < 10. `onTimeFramePercent` = (1 − `lateFrames`/`totalFrames`) × 100, a share of frames (§4.21). `longTaskBlockedMsPerSec` = `summary.renderer.longTaskTotalMs` / run length `run.endMonotonicTs − run.startMonotonicTs` (`benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:106` (`runSec`); §4.20). |
| `kpis.startup.{panelsReadyMs, firstMessageMs}`                                                                      | From `summary.phases`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `kpis.throughput.{ingestMiBPerSec, messagesPerSec, fanout}`                                                         | From `summary.pipeline`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `kpis.renderCost.{worstPanelP90RenderMs, worstPanelId, worstPanelType, p90RenderMsByPanelType}`                     | `benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:117` (`renderCostKpis`), max of per-panel `renderP90WindowMaxMs` (a p90 of per-window maxima, see §3.4). Empty for Plot-only scenarios (§4.23).                                                                                                                                                                                |

Scorecard (viewer only): `benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:402` (`aggregateKpis`) aggregates
non-overhead runs with `benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:224` (`aggregateValues`) using
`benchmark/e2e/result/constants.ts:259` (`SCORECARD_POLICIES`): **geomean** for magnitudes
(memory, CPU, startup, throughput), **max (worst)** for slope and `longTaskBlockedMsPerSec`,
**min (worst)** for `medianFps`, `fpsPercentOfCeiling`, `onTimeFramePercent`, `ingestMiBPerSec`;
render cost uses max. Overhead reports are aggregated separately
(`benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:365` (`aggregateOverhead`)).

Group KPIs (`benchmark/e2e/result/constants.ts:285` (`GROUP_KPIS`), values via
`benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:460` (`GROUP_VALUE`), aggregation
`benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:510` (`groupKpis`)):

| Group (scenarios)            | Primary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Secondary                                                                               |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `3d-rendering` (pc, tf)      | `onTimeFramePercent` (min)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `p90Render3dMs`, `peakTotalWorkingSetMiB`                                               |
| `time-series` (sw)           | `p90RenderPlotMs`, falling back to `listenerDispatchP90Ms` = `summary.listenerDispatchDurationMs.p90 ?? summary.pipeline.listenerDispatchP90WindowMaxMs` (`benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:465` (`listenerDispatchP90Ms`)); Plot emits no render telemetry, so the fallback is what you see (§4.23) | `messagesPerSec`, `medianCpuPercent`                                                    |
| `preloading` (tfp)           | `preloadDurationMs`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `blockCachePeakMiB`, `workingSetSlopeMiBPerMin`                                         |
| `real-pipeline-ingest` (mmi) | `cpuSecondsPerMiB`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `ingestMiBPerSec`, `poolEvictions`, `poolRehydrations`, `poolInvariantViolations` (sum) |

Only `IterablePlayer` emits `preload`, so synthetic tfp has no `preloadDurationMs` and the
preloading group shows `n=0` by design.

### 2.3 Overhead report (schema 3, built by `benchmark/e2e/runner/overhead.ts:316` (`buildOverheadReport`))

Overhead scenarios: `benchmark/e2e/runner/constants.ts:115` (`OVERHEAD_SCENARIOS`) = sw, mmi, pc.
Targets: `benchmark/e2e/runner/constants.ts:100` (`OVERHEAD_TARGETS`) =
`{cpuDeltaRelativeMax: 0.02, memDeltaBytesMax: 20971520}` (copied to `targets`). **Fixed; never
suggest changing them.**

| JSON path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemaVersion` (3), `kind`, `platform`, `scenarioId`, `createdAtWall`, `method`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Identity. `method` is `toggle`, `relaunch` or `both` (default) (`benchmark/e2e/runner/overhead.types.ts:30` (`OverheadMethod`), `benchmark/e2e/runner/constants.ts:172` (`OVERHEAD_DEFAULT_METHOD`)); absent in legacy reports.                                                                                                                    |
| `config.{repeats, warmupRuns, arms, warmupMs, polls, sampleIntervalMs, method, toggle{quartets, blockMs, settleMs, warmupMs, drainIntervalMs}}`                                                                                                                                                                         | Run config.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `runs[].{arm, repeat, order, sequence, resultFile, telemetryEnabled, steady}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Relaunch arms (`resultFile` = per-arm v1 file).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `pairs[].{comparison, repeat, order, baseArm, treatmentArm, deltas{cpuRelative, cpuPctPoints, memBytes, memBytesCommonProcesses, mainThreadBlockedMsPerSec, fps}, excluded, reasons, flags}`                                                                                                                            | Relaunch pairs; `flags` may contain `processSetMismatch`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `n`, `excludedPairs`, `processSetMismatches`, `windowMismatchRuns`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Pair accounting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `metrics.<key>.{n, median, iqr, ci95{lower, upper}}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Bootstrap stats (`benchmark/e2e/result/stats.ts:115` (`bootstrapMedianCi95`)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `verdicts.{cpu, memory, overall}`, `cpuVerdictSource`, `memVerdictSource`, `relaunchVerdicts`                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `within` / `exceeds` / `inconclusive` (`benchmark/e2e/result/stats.ts:166` (`verdict`), worst-of `benchmark/e2e/result/stats.ts:182` (`worstVerdict`)).                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `toggle.{method, config, n, excludedQuartets, metrics{cpuRelative, cpuPctPoints}, verdict, modalProcessSet, flaggedBlocks, lateStartBlocks, toggleLatencyMsMax, uaCalls{onBlocks, offBlocks}, rendererRecords, runDurationMs}`                                                                                          | In-process toggle (`benchmark/e2e/runner/toggleBlocks.ts:358` (`summarizeToggle`)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `toggle.blocks[].{…, cpuPercentByProcessType, processSet, recordsByRealm, flags}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Blocks (`benchmark/e2e/runner/toggleBlocks.ts:155` (`buildToggleBlocks`)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `toggle.quartets[].{index, order, offBlocks, onBlocks, offCpuPercent, onCpuPercent, cpuRelative, cpuPctPoints, excluded, reasons}`                                                                                                                                                                                      | ABBA quartets (`benchmark/e2e/runner/toggleBlocks.ts:252` (`buildToggleQuartets`)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `toggleWithoutUaProbe`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Same shape, UA probe disabled (`BENCHMARK_OVERHEAD_UA_ARM=1`, web).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `toggleFrameProbe`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Same shape with the FPS probe active (`BENCHMARK_OVERHEAD_FRAME_PROBE_ARM=1`). Harness cost; **never part of verdicts**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `directAttribution.{status, config{profileMs, samplingIntervalUs, telemetrySources[]}, durationMs, samples, jsMsPerSec, telemetryMsPerSec, unresolvedMsPerSec, resolvedShare, gcMsPerSec, gcShare, offCpuPercent, offCpuMsPerSec, relative, relativeUpperBound, topFunctions[{source, line, name, msPerSec}], verdict}` | CDP CPU profile attribution (`benchmark/e2e/result/directAttribution.ts:215` (`buildDirectAttribution`), `benchmark/e2e/result/directAttribution.ts:135` (`attributeCpuProfile`), verdict `benchmark/e2e/result/directAttribution.ts:190` (`directAttributionVerdict`)). `topFunctions[].line` is source-mapped from the build at run time (§3.8). |
| `withoutUaProbe`, `uaCost`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Relaunch: on-without-UA vs off (with verdicts), and on vs on-without-UA.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `selfCost.{n, msPerSec, fractionOfCore, recordsPerSec, meanEmitNs, estimatedEmitMsPerSec, uaCalls, uaResolved, uaFailures, uaResolveMsMean}`                                                                                                                                                                            | Self-reported cost from `summary.telemetrySelf`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `targets`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Copy of `OVERHEAD_TARGETS`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

Older reports are normalized on read: v1 (`{off, on, deltas, targets, withinTargets, within}`) by
`benchmark/e2e/result/overheadLegacy.ts:72` (`normalizeLegacyOverheadReport`) to `n=1`,
`inconclusive`, `legacy: true`; v2 by `benchmark/e2e/result/overheadLegacy.ts:127`
(`normalizeV2OverheadReport`) to method `relaunch`; a pair-based toggle by
`benchmark/e2e/result/overheadLegacy.ts:144` (`normalizePairToggleReport`). Treat legacy
verdicts as `inconclusive` regardless of their deltas.

### 2.4 Extraction recipes

Read-only one-liners for Node (always available in this repo). Run them from the repository root;
the first argument is the artifact directory (default `benchmark/.artifacts`). `jq` is optional
(not guaranteed to be installed; e.g. `jq '.summary.kpis' <file>`); prefer these snippets. They
only read files and print `key=value` lines; quote the printed values with the file name.

**Groups, newest and previous file per group** (key `scenarioId|platform|mode|telemetry|uaMemory`,
mode resolved as in §1):

```sh
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const dir = process.argv[1] ?? "benchmark/.artifacts";
const groups = {};
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((name) => name.endsWith(".benchmark-result.v1.json"))) {
  const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), "utf8"));
  const mode = r.run.mode ?? (r.summary.steadyWindow ? "overhead" : "scenario");
  const tel = r.run.telemetryEnabled ? "on" : "off";
  const ua = r.run.environment.collectors?.uaMemory ?? "-";
  const key = [r.run.scenarioId, r.run.platform, mode, tel, ua].join("|");
  (groups[key] ??= []).push({ f, ts: Number(/-(\d+)\.benchmark-result/.exec(f)[1]) });
}
for (const key of Object.keys(groups).sort()) {
  const runs = groups[key].sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts);
  console.log(`${key} n=${runs.length} newest=${runs[0].f} previous=${runs[1]?.f ?? "-"}`);
}' benchmark/.artifacts
```

**KPIs and key summary fields of the newest and previous run per group**; the second argument is
a substring filter on the group key (default `|scenario|on|`, e.g. `"sinewave|web|scenario|on|"`):

```sh
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const [dir = "benchmark/.artifacts", filter = "|scenario|on|"] = process.argv.slice(1);
const read = (f) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), "utf8"));
const groups = {};
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((name) => name.endsWith(".benchmark-result.v1.json"))) {
  const r = read(f);
  const mode = r.run.mode ?? (r.summary.steadyWindow ? "overhead" : "scenario");
  const tel = r.run.telemetryEnabled ? "on" : "off";
  const ua = r.run.environment.collectors?.uaMemory ?? "-";
  const key = [r.run.scenarioId, r.run.platform, mode, tel, ua].join("|");
  (groups[key] ??= []).push({ f, ts: Number(/-(\d+)\.benchmark-result/.exec(f)[1]) });
}
const flat = (obj, prefix, out = []) => {
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj ?? {})) {
    const nested = v !== null && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v);
    if (nested && Object.keys(v).length > 0) flat(v, `${prefix}.${k}`, out);
    else out.push(`${prefix}.${k}=${typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : v}`);
  }
  return out;
};
for (const key of Object.keys(groups).sort().filter((k) => k.includes(filter))) {
  const runs = groups[key].sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts);
  for (const [label, run] of [["newest", runs[0]], ["previous", runs[1]]]) {
    if (run == undefined) continue;
    const { run: meta, summary: s, dropped, sequenceGaps } = read(run.f);
    const env = meta.environment;
    console.log(`## ${key} ${label} n=${runs.length} file=${run.f}`);
    console.log([
      `windowMs=${Math.round((meta.windowEndMonotonicTs ?? meta.endMonotonicTs) - meta.startMonotonicTs)}`,
      `runMs=${Math.round(meta.endMonotonicTs - meta.startMonotonicTs)}`,
      `env.logicalCpus=${env.logicalCpus ?? "-"}`,
      `env.webBrowser=${env.webBrowser ?? "-"}`,
      `env.fpsCeiling=${env.fpsCeiling ?? "-"}`,
      `env.glRenderer=${env.glRenderer ?? "-"}`,
      `process.sampleCount=${s.process.sampleCount}`,
      `renderer.totalFrames=${s.renderer.totalFrames ?? "-"}`,
      `renderer.longTaskTotalMs=${s.renderer.longTaskTotalMs ?? "-"}`,
      `phases.origin=${s.phases.origin ?? "-"}`,
      `phases.panelsReadyCoverage=${JSON.stringify(s.phases.panelsReadyCoverage ?? {})}`,
      `dropped=${JSON.stringify(dropped)}`,
      `sequenceGaps=${JSON.stringify(sequenceGaps)}`,
      `telemetrySelf=${s.telemetrySelf ? "present" : "absent"}`,
      ...(s.kpis ? flat(s.kpis, "kpis") : ["kpis=absent (older file; the viewer backfills them)"]),
    ].join("\n"));
  }
}' benchmark/.artifacts "sinewave|web|scenario|on|"
```

**Newest overhead report per scenario/platform**: verdicts, toggle, direct-attribution and
relaunch medians with CI95 (relative values are fractions: `0.02` = 2 %):

```sh
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const dir = process.argv[1] ?? "benchmark/.artifacts";
const newest = {};
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((name) => /^overhead-.+-\d+\.json$/.test(name))) {
  const ts = Number(/-(\d+)\.json$/.exec(f)[1]);
  const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), "utf8"));
  const key = `${r.scenarioId}|${r.platform}`;
  if (newest[key] == undefined || ts > newest[key].ts) newest[key] = { f, ts, r };
}
const num = (v) => (typeof v === "number" ? Number(v.toPrecision(4)) : "-");
const stat = (m) =>
  m == undefined ? "-" : `median=${num(m.median)} ci95=[${num(m.ci95?.lower)}, ${num(m.ci95?.upper)}] n=${m.n}`;
for (const key of Object.keys(newest).sort()) {
  const { f, r } = newest[key];
  const da = r.directAttribution;
  console.log([
    `## ${key} file=${f}`,
    `schemaVersion=${r.schemaVersion} method=${r.method ?? "-"} n=${r.n ?? "-"}`,
    `verdicts=${JSON.stringify(r.verdicts ?? "-")} cpuVerdictSource=${r.cpuVerdictSource ?? "-"} memVerdictSource=${r.memVerdictSource ?? "-"}`,
    `toggle.verdict=${r.toggle?.verdict ?? "-"} toggle.n=${r.toggle?.n ?? "-"}`,
    `toggle.cpuRelative ${stat(r.toggle?.metrics?.cpuRelative)}`,
    `toggle.cpuPctPoints ${stat(r.toggle?.metrics?.cpuPctPoints)}`,
    `direct.status=${da?.status ?? "-"} direct.verdict=${da?.verdict ?? "-"} direct.relative=${num(da?.relative)} direct.relativeUpperBound=${num(da?.relativeUpperBound)} direct.telemetryMsPerSec=${num(da?.telemetryMsPerSec)}`,
    `relaunchVerdicts=${JSON.stringify(r.relaunchVerdicts ?? "-")}`,
    `relaunch.cpuRelative ${stat(r.metrics?.cpuRelative)}`,
    `relaunch.memBytes ${stat(r.metrics?.memBytes)}`,
    `relaunch.mainThreadBlockedMsPerSec ${stat(r.metrics?.mainThreadBlockedMsPerSec)}`,
    `targets=${JSON.stringify(r.targets)}`,
  ].join("\n"));
}' benchmark/.artifacts
```

A report with `schemaVersion` 1 prints `verdicts="-"` (legacy shape, §2.3): treat it as
`inconclusive`. For a single file, read it directly or use `jq` if installed.

---

## 3. Metric → code catalog

Columns: **Metric/KPI** (name exactly as in `samples[].metric`, `events[].name` or the JSON
path), **Unit / meaning**, **Produced at** (where the number is emitted or computed), **Influenced
by** (product code whose behavior moves the number), **Scenarios** (where it appears in results).

Paths abbreviated in this section: `MP` = `packages/suite-base/src/components/MessagePipeline`,
`PEA` = `packages/suite-base/src/components/PanelExtensionAdapter`, `IP` =
`packages/suite-base/src/players/IterablePlayer`. References always spell the full path.

## 4. Interpretation rules & pitfalls

1. **CPU is a per-core sum.** 100 % = one core; 227 % is 2.3 cores, not saturation. Normalize by
   `run.environment.logicalCpus` only when comparing machines; if `logicalCpus` is missing, do not
   compare absolute CPU across hosts (and see §4.19 for older Electron files).
2. **FPS is bounded by the calibrated ceiling** (`run.environment.fpsCeiling`, e.g. 120 on a
   ProMotion display, 60 on CI). Compare `fpsPercentOfCeiling` / `onTimeFramePercent`, not raw
   fps, across machines. Ceilings below `benchmark/e2e/runner/constants.ts:290`
   (`MIN_PLAUSIBLE_FPS_CEILING`) (20) fall back to the default late threshold `LATE_FRAME_THRESHOLD_MS` (1.5 × 60 Hz = 25 ms).
3. **Web GPU differs.** Check `run.environment.glRenderer`: `SwiftShader` (software GL, typical on
   CI/headless Linux) makes web 3D fps very low and CPU high; this is environment, not a product
   regression. Metal/ANGLE vs SwiftShader runs are not comparable.
4. **Late frame = delta > 1.5 × 1000 / ceiling** (`run.environment.lateFrameThresholdMs`, e.g.
   12.5 ms at 120 Hz). A run without a calibrated threshold uses the 25 ms default.
5. **Slope needs ≥ 10 s** after warm-up (`benchmark/e2e/result/constants.ts:132`
   (`MIN_SLOPE_WINDOW_MS`), warm-up fraction `benchmark/e2e/result/constants.ts:123`
   (`STEADY_STATE_WARMUP_FRACTION`), min points `benchmark/e2e/result/constants.ts:126`
   (`MIN_SLOPE_POINTS`)). Short runs (mmi = 10 s total) have no slope; a large positive slope in a
   short run usually reflects startup allocation, not a leak; confirm with a longer run.
6. **Steady window** (overhead runs): `summary.steadyWindow.polls` may be 3–4 in heavy web 3D runs
   (poll overruns); `windowMismatch: true` or `overruns > 0` lowers confidence.
7. **Noise vs signal.** A single run is an anecdote. Use `n`, `median`, `iqr`, `ci95` when
   present. `inconclusive` ≠ regression: it means the CI straddles the target or `n` is below
   `MIN_PAIRS_FOR_VERDICT` (3 pairs) / `MIN_QUARTETS_FOR_VERDICT` (6 quartets). Default quartets:
   `benchmark/e2e/runner/constants.ts:180` (`OVERHEAD_TOGGLE_DEFAULT_QUARTETS`) (10).
8. **Peak working set is multi-modal locally.** Repeated runs of pc, sw, tf and mmi cluster about
   150–250 MiB apart. Require ≥ 3 runs per side before calling a memory change; report the
   spread you observed.
9. **The FPS probe is harness, not product.** `toggleFrameProbe` measures the cost of the frame
   collector itself (~+7.5 % CPU observed); never attribute it to shipped code and never mix it
   into verdicts.
10. **UA-memory probe**: forces a GC, web only, needs `crossOriginIsolated` and full Chromium
    (headless shell rejects: `uaFailures > 0`, no `renderer.uaSpecificMemory.bytes`). Its cost is
    reported separately (`uaCost`, `toggleWithoutUaProbe`).
11. **Process sets differ.** Electron and web expose different processes (`summary.process.byType`
    keys, `steadyWindow.processSet`, `toggle.modalProcessSet`). Never compare total working set
    across platforms; `processSetMismatch` pairs are excluded.
12. **Memory sources double-count.** `process.workingSetBytes` counts shared pages per process;
    `renderer.jsHeap.*` covers only the page realm (not workers, not GPU). Do not add them.
13. **`OVERHEAD_TARGETS` are fixed** (2 % CPU, 20 MiB). Never propose relaxing them; propose
    reducing cost or improving measurement instead.
14. **Screenshots distort metrics.** `BENCHMARK_SCREENSHOTS=all`
    (`benchmark/e2e/runner/constants.ts:250` (`SCREENSHOTS_ENV_VAR`)) captures during the window;
    web pc dropped from ~3.7–3.9 fps to ~1.3–1.6 fps. Discard such runs for KPIs.
15. **Latency ≠ CPU.** `listenerDispatchDurationMs` and `panel.render.durationMs` include waiting
    (promises, React scheduling); they can rise without CPU rising. 3D render duration is commit
    latency, not GPU time.
16. **Fan-out semantics differ.** `deliveredFanout` = delivered / received; < 1 means some
    received messages had no subscriber (pc 0.6), > 1 means several panels share topics.
17. **Startup origins differ** (`summary.phases.origin`): `app.ready` (synthetic) vs
    `datasource.open` (mmi). Compare startup only within the same origin.
18. **Never mix `run.mode: "overhead"` files or `telemetry-off` runs into scenario KPIs.** Resolve
    a missing `run.mode` as in §1: legacy overhead arms are named like scenario runs.
19. **Old Electron CPU is on a different scale.** Electron files **without**
    `run.environment.logicalCpus` were written before `toPerCoreSumPercent`
    (`benchmark/e2e/runner/hostCpus.ts:21` (`toPerCoreSumPercent`)) and report
    `process.cpuPercent` / `medianTotalCpuPercent` as % of **all** CPUs (e.g. ~16 % instead of
    ~225 % for sinewave on a 14-CPU host). Multiply by the host's logical CPU count (same host
    only) or exclude them; **never call the jump a regression**.
20. **`longTaskBlockedMsPerSec` is mostly startup in short runs.** The long-task observer uses
    `buffered: true` (`benchmark/src/telemetry/collectors/LongTaskCollector.ts:62` (`buffered`)),
    the summary takes the max of the cumulative counter
    (`benchmark/e2e/result/schemaV1.ts:594` (`longTaskTotalMs`)) and the KPI divides it by the
    run length (`benchmark/e2e/result/kpis.ts:106` (`runSec`)). For 5–10 s scenarios the value
    is dominated by bootstrap and is inversely proportional to the run length. Before reading it
    as steady-state jank, check that `samples[]` with `metric: "renderer.longTasks.durationMs"`
    still increase after the first sample; a single sample (it is published only on change) means
    all long tasks happened at bootstrap.
21. **`onTimeFramePercent` is a share of frames, not of time.** A run with few, very long frames
    can still show a high percentage. When `lowFps` is true or `summary.renderer.totalFrames`
    is below ~100, read `medianFps` and `longTaskBlockedMsPerSec` instead.
22. **Host CPU medians come from few samples.** `summary.process.sampleCount` is 4–6 in 5 s
    scenarios (≈ 10–15 in longer ones), and web polls are irregular. Treat single-run CPU deltas
    below ~15 % as noise; require repeats (§5.6).
23. **Plot has no render telemetry.** Plot (and RawMessages) do not go through
    `PanelExtensionAdapter`, so they emit no `panel.render.*` (only subscriber and range
    telemetry). Consequences: `p90RenderPlotMs` is missing (the time-series group shows the
    `listenerDispatchP90Ms` fallback), `kpis.renderCost` is empty for sw/mmi,
    `panelsReadyCoverage.firstRendered` is `0` and `panelsReadyMs` is the latest panel **mount**
    time (`benchmark/e2e/result/panelsSummary.ts:229` (`readyTs`)), not a render time.
24. **`mounts: 2` in mmi is teardown, not remount churn.** Plot and RawMessages log
    `panel.unmount` + a second `panel.mount` between `datasource.close` start and end, after
    `run.windowEndMonotonicTs`. Only a second mount **inside** the window indicates a remount.
25. **p90 window-max KPIs are near-maxima.** `renderP90WindowMaxMs`, `kpis.renderCost.*`,
    `p90Render3dMs` and `listenerDispatchP90WindowMaxMs` are the nearest-rank p90 of per-window
    maxima (`benchmark/e2e/result/series.ts:138` (`p90WindowMax`),
    `benchmark/e2e/result/stats.ts:24` (`percentile`)). With ≤ 9 windows they equal the single
    worst window, often the first-frame window; one slow first render moves them. Cross-check
    `renderMeanMs`, `renders` and the `.max` series over time before claiming a regression.

## 5. Baseline comparison rules (read both sets; recipes in §2.4)

1. **Match** files by the §1 group key `scenarioId|platform|mode|telemetry|uaMemory`.
   Unmatched scenarios are reported as gaps, never as regressions.
2. **Pick the most recent baseline with the same config fingerprint**, not blindly the
   previous file. Fingerprint:
   - window length `run.windowEndMonotonicTs − run.startMonotonicTs` (fallback
     `run.endMonotonicTs`) within ±10 %;
   - similar `summary.process.sampleCount` (e.g. 5 vs 15 means a different scenario duration);
   - same `run.environment.collectors.uaMemory` (including "missing");
   - same presence of `run.environment.logicalCpus` and `run.environment.webBrowser` (proxy for
     the harness version; also decides the Electron CPU scale, §4.19);
   - same screenshot mode, when recorded (`-loaded`/`-mid` PNGs for the `<ts>`, §1).
     Walk back from the newest older file until all match; if the chosen baseline is not the
     literal previous run, **state which files were skipped and why**.
3. **Check the environment first**: `cpuModel`, `logicalCpus`, `totalMemBytes`, `ci`,
   `fpsCeiling`, `glRenderer`, `electronVersion`, `chromiumVersion`, `webBrowser`,
   `crossOriginIsolated`. Any difference → state it and downgrade confidence; CI vs local is
   never comparable in absolute terms.
4. **Stability gates comparison**: if `kpis.stability.healthy` is false on either side, compare
   nothing else for that scenario; report the reasons.
5. **Compare medians with n**: with several runs per side, compare the median of each KPI and
   report `n` per side and the min–max spread. With one run per side, say so.
6. **Signal rule**: a delta counts as signal only if it lies outside run-to-run noise:
   use CI95/IQR when present (overhead reports); otherwise require the delta to exceed the
   observed spread on both sides **and** to be consistent across platforms or repeats.
   Otherwise write "within noise".
7. **Schema gaps**: a KPI missing on one side (older schema, `recomputed: true`, slope window too
   short) is a data gap, not a change.
8. **Staleness**: if the baseline `<ts>` is older than the relevant code changes you cite, say so.

---

## 6. Analysis workflow

1. **Locate**: list `*.benchmark-result.v1.json` and `overhead-*.json` and group them as in §1
   (recipes in §2.4); pick the newest per group (largest `<ts>`) and the baseline per §5.2; note
   all repeats.
2. **Validate**: `schemaVersion`, `run.mode` (resolved as in §1), `run.telemetryEnabled`,
   environment (§5.3), `dropped`, `sequenceGaps` (any value > 0), missing scenarios (possible
   error-boundary failure).
3. **Triage**: per scenario/platform read `summary.kpis`; flag `stability.healthy: false`,
   `lowFps`, worst `renderCost`, large `longTaskBlockedMsPerSec`, positive slope, pool
   `invariantHolds: false`; for overhead reports read `verdicts`, `toggle.verdict`, `flags`.
4. **Drill down**: from the KPI to its `summary.*` source, then to raw `samples[]` /
   `events[]` (filter by `metric` and `labels.panelId` / `labels.processType`); check
   `summary.process.byType` to find which process moved.
5. **Correlate to code**: metric name → producer (§3) → product path in "Influenced by" →
   recent changes: `git --no-pager log --oneline -n 20 -- <path>`,
   `git --no-pager log -p -S "<symbol>" -- <path>`, `git --no-pager blame -L <start>,<end> <path>`.
   Read the code; cite `path:line`.
6. **Hypotheses**: rank by evidence strength (multiple independent metrics agreeing > one KPI;
   reproducible across platforms > single platform).
7. **Experiments** (suggest exact commands; the user runs them):
   - Re-run one scenario: `yarn test:e2e:benchmark scenarios -g <scenarioId>` (Electron) or
     `yarn test:e2e:benchmark:web scenarios -g <scenarioId>`; repeat ≥ 3 times; keep
     `BENCHMARK_SCREENSHOTS` unset or `0`.
   - Overhead: `yarn test:e2e:benchmark overhead -g <scenarioId>` (or `:web`); smoke:
     `BENCHMARK_OVERHEAD_METHOD=toggle BENCHMARK_OVERHEAD_TOGGLE_QUARTETS=4 yarn test:e2e:benchmark overhead -g sinewave`;
     probes `BENCHMARK_OVERHEAD_UA_ARM=1`, `BENCHMARK_OVERHEAD_FRAME_PROBE_ARM=1`; other knobs
     in `benchmark/e2e/runner/constants.ts:212` (`OVERHEAD_ENV`) and `benchmark/README.md`.
   - Direct attribution (CDP profile) is part of toggle overhead runs; read
     `directAttribution.topFunctions`.
   - Manual profiling: `yarn benchmark:serve` and record a DevTools Performance profile on the
     scenario URL.
   - View: `yarn test:e2e:benchmark:viewer --dir <dir> --open`; summary:
     `yarn test:e2e:benchmark:summary`.
   - Harness unit tests after harness questions: `yarn jest --selectProjects benchmark-e2e`.
8. **Route fixes** to the owning agent (Write-Ownership in `.github/agents/lb-orchestrator.agent.md`):

| Code area                                                                                                                   | Owner agent                                     |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `packages/suite-base/src/players/**` (IterablePlayer, BlockLoader, caches, pool, MCAP)                                      | `@lb-player`                                    |
| `packages/suite-base/src/components/MessagePipeline/**`                                                                     | `@lb-message-pipeline`                          |
| `packages/suite-base/src/components/PanelExtensionAdapter/**`                                                               | `@lb-panels-general`                            |
| `packages/suite-base/src/panels/ThreeDeeRender/**`                                                                          | `@lb-panel-3d`                                  |
| `packages/suite-base/src/panels/Plot/**`                                                                                    | `@lb-panel-plot`                                |
| `packages/suite-base/src/panels/RawMessages/**`                                                                             | `@lb-panel-raw-messages`                        |
| `packages/suite-base/src/components/**` (other), `hooks/**`, `context/**`                                                   | `@lb-frontend-dev`                              |
| `packages/suite-base/src/providers/CurrentLayoutProvider/**`                                                                | `@lb-layouts`                                   |
| `desktop/**`, `packages/suite-desktop/**`                                                                                   | `@lb-desktop`                                   |
| `web/**`, `packages/suite-web/**`                                                                                           | `@lb-web`                                       |
| Unit tests                                                                                                                  | `@lb-unit-test`                                 |
| `benchmark/**` (harness), `packages/suite-base/src/util/**` (incl. `util/telemetry`), `packages/suite-base/src/PanelAPI/**` | no owning agent: human or general-purpose agent |

## 7. Output contract

1. **Summary** (3–6 lines): what was analyzed (dirs, scenarios, platforms, n), headline
   findings, overall confidence.
2. **Findings**, ranked by confidence and impact, **at most ~8** unless the user asks for more.
   Either the wide table:

   | #   | Metric evidence (file → JSON path = value) | Code evidence (path:line) | Interpretation | Confidence (high/med/low) | Suggested action / experiment | Owner agent |
   | --- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ----------- |

   or, for CLI readability, a compact table plus one evidence list per finding (same content):

   | #   | Finding | Confidence | Owner agent |
   | --- | ------- | ---------- | ----------- |

   ```
   #1 <title>
   - Metric evidence: <file> → <JSON path> = <value> (vs <baseline file> = <value>)
   - Code evidence: <path:line> (<symbol>)
   - Interpretation: <what it means, incl. relevant §4 pitfalls>
   - Action / experiment: <exact command or change, routed to the owner>
   ```

3. **Facts** (quoted values, verified code lines) and **Hypotheses** (explanations, untested
   causal claims) in separate lists.
4. **Open questions / data gaps** (missing runs, environment mismatch, n too small, metrics not
   emitted).

Rules: never invent numbers — every number is quoted from an artifact with its file and JSON
path (or computed from quoted numbers, showing the formula). Quote identifiers verbatim. Answer
in the user's language. Never modify, create or delete files; shell use is limited to the
read-only commands of §2.4 / §6; route fixes to owner agents.
